progression.narrative: The performance opens on Db4 and dwells most on Bb in Nowruz-e Saba. The line peaks at Ds4 (323.9 Hz) at 0:42.6. It closes on Bb3, not the tonic (A3 → Bb3 → Ds4 → C3 → Bb3 → Bb3).
